headline: UK and EU Reach Food Deal to Remove Vast Majority of Physical Checks
summary: British producers welcomed a new UK-EU deal designed to remove the vast majority of physical checks on food, plants, and animal products. Exporters praised the agreement, though some expressed frustration at the implementation timeline.
why: Sanitary and phytosanitary agreements govern agricultural and food trade rules between jurisdictions, directly affecting border friction, supply chain costs, and compliance burdens for food producers and exporters.

impacts.name: Food & Beverage Exporters
impacts.why: Removal of physical checks reduces trade friction and compliance costs for British food exporters.
